question.text: A force F of magnitude 8 N acts at 45° above the horizontal. Split this force into its horizontal and vertical components.
conditions: force F makes an angle of 45° with the horizontal

figure.description: A force F drawn as a diagonal arrow at 45° above the horizontal from the origin. Dashed lines complete a right-angled box, with the horizontal side labelled F_H, the vertical side labelled F_V, and the 45° angle marked between F and the horizontal side.

solution.approach: Split the force into horizontal and vertical parts using the cosine and sine of the given angle.

steps.text: The force F makes 45° with the horizontal, so its horizontal part is F cos 45° and its vertical part is F sin 45°.
steps.equation: F_H = F cos 45°, F_V = F sin 45°

steps.text: Put in F = 8 N and cos 45° = sin 45° = 0.7071.
The vertical part comes out the same, since sin 45° equals cos 45°.
steps.why_this_step: At 45°, the two right-angle components of any force are always equal.

common_mistakes.text: Taking F_H = F and F_V = 0 by ignoring that the force is tilted, instead of resolving it.
